São Paulo State rivers: Ribeira de Iguape, Iporanga, Preto (São Paulo, Sete Barras).

Type locality: Rio Preto close to the STB-420 road, tributary of the Rio Ipiranga, which is a tributary of the Rio Juquiá, Rio Ribeira do Iguape basin, Município de Sete Barras, Estado de São Paulo, Brazil, 24°11'36"S, 47°53'26"W, elevation about 25 meters.
